title: Vial of Blood

sources.title: Vial of Blood
markers: '''Vial of Blood''' is a common [[Miscellaneous]] item. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to [[Traders]].

summary: Breaking the vial creates a Blood surface.

fields.Break: Creates Blood when destroyed. Blood douses unprotected flames and can freeze. Walking through ordinary Blood does not itself grant a condition.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
